notes.title: Important news regarding the expected 2022 release.
notes.notes:
We Survive Tonight will be making the switch into another engine and this might delay the expected 2022 release.

This decision was not easy to do but after analyzing all the possible options, the current engine is a huge bottleneck that greatly deteriorates the development cycle for We Survive Tonight, more specifically, the network and multiplayer features of the game.

If more time is spent trying to develop the game than actually developing the game, then a switch is the best option possible.

The engine switch will make We Survive Tonight the best it can be and will allow me to properly translate my vision of the game into the final product/

Thanks for your support and understanding!
- Dark
